title.narrative: Trinidad and Tobago - Technical Assistance to the Joint Select Committee

description.narrative: Providing a consultant to the Joint Commitee of the Parliament of Trinidad and Tobago who will review the newly drafted Bill, together with the Cabinet approved policy that informed its content, the notes of prior deliberations of the JSC, stakeholder comments and JSC reports in order to:  advise on the sufficiency of its content;  provide advice on international comparative practices and legislation that address the aims and objectives of the policy and bill; and  identify any legislative gapsif any and provide recommendationsfor addressing the same. It is critical that the advice and recommendationsrequired are be contextualized to Trinidad and Tobago’s political, legal and constitutional realities. The consultant is required therefore to ensure that regional and international best practice is encapsulated into the reform of existing law and introduction of a new modern regulatory framework for election campaign financing.
